items.note: User confirmed October 13. Bush beans about 3.5 servings x 90 = 315 kcal; DeLallo ripe olives about 7 servings x 20 = 140 kcal. Additional half-container blue cheese assumed usual 2 oz, estimated 200 kcal; approximately 2 tbsp regular mustard estimated 20 kcal. Included kit dressing retained, no extra dressing. No chicken or additional crunchy toppings reported. Meal remains estimated because croutons, blue cheese and mustard not weighed or label-verified; complete macros unknown.
